DDB.Settings.CobaltCookie.Name: D&D Beyond CobaltSession Cookie
DDB.Settings.CobaltCookie.Hint: Your D&D Beyond CobaltSession cookie value. Find this in your browser dev tools: Application > Cookies > dndbeyond.com > CobaltSession. This is used to obtain an access token for the WebSocket connection.
DDB.Settings.ProxyUrl.Name: DDB Proxy URL
DDB.Settings.ProxyUrl.Hint: Proxy server URL to bypass CORS restrictions when communicating with D&D Beyond. Default uses the DDB Importer proxy.
DDB.Settings.CharacterMapping.Name: Character Mapping
DDB.Settings.CharacterMapping.Label: Configure Mappings
DDB.Settings.CharacterMapping.Hint: Map D&D Beyond characters to Foundry actors for dice roll synchronization.
DDB.Settings.UserId.Name: D&D Beyond Cobalt User ID
DDB.Settings.UserId.Hint: The ID of your account in D&D Beyond. When on your D&D Beyond campaign, find this by running console.log(Cobalt.User.ID) from browser console.
DDB.Settings.CampaignId.Name: Campaign ID
DDB.Settings.CampaignId.Hint: The ID of your D&D Beyond campaign. You can find this in your campaign's URL.
DDB.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable DDB Dice Sync
DDB.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Enable or disable the connection to D&D Beyond. When enabled, dice rolls from DDB will be synced to Foundry.
DDB.Settings.UpdateDamageOnly.Name: Update Character Damage From D&D Beyond
DDB.Settings.UpdateDamageOnly.Hint: When enabled, character damage from D&D Beyond will sync.
DDB.Settings.SyncConditions.Name: Update Character Conditions From D&D Beyond
DDB.Settings.SyncConditions.Hint: When enabled, conditions a player sets on their D&D Beyond character sheet (including exhaustion levels) are applied to the mapped Foundry actor, and conditions removed on D&D Beyond are removed in Foundry. Only the 15 core 5e conditions are touched; other status effects are left alone.
DDB.Settings.NotifySpellSlots.Name: Announce Spells Cast on D&D Beyond in Chat
DDB.Settings.NotifySpellSlots.Hint: Posts a chat message when a player spends a spell slot or pact magic slot on their D&D Beyond sheet. D&D Beyond only reports the slot level, not which spell; cantrips spend no slot and are not announced.
DDB.Settings.NotifySpellSlotsGmOnly.Name: Spell Announcements to GM Only
DDB.Settings.NotifySpellSlotsGmOnly.Hint: Whisper spell slot announcements to the GM instead of posting them publicly.
DDB.Settings.PostSpellCards.Name: Post Spell Cards for D&D Beyond Spell Rolls
DDB.Settings.PostSpellCards.Hint: When a D&D Beyond roll belongs to a spell on the mapped actor, post that spell's card to chat once per cast (attack and damage rolls share one card). Nothing is consumed or rolled. Spells with an area of effect get a Place template button for the GM and the actor's owner. While a card is shown, the separate spell slot announcement is skipped.
DDB.Settings.SpellTemplateCleanup.Name: Remove Spell Templates in Combat
DDB.Settings.SpellTemplateCleanup.Hint: When templates placed from a spell card are deleted during combat. Templates placed outside combat are never removed automatically.
DDB.SpellTemplate.Unavailable: DDB Sync: this spell's template cannot be placed (no active scene or dnd5e template support).
